title: shirakiopsis indica
intro: Shirakiopsis indica, commonly known as Indian Butter Tree, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of India. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, relieve pain and inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Shirakiopsis indica include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antidiabetic activities, which contribute to its use in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Shirakiopsis indica include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
